## Website overview

This website brings together my background, a CEP project dashboard, and examples of website customization. I organized the content into four navigation tabs so visitors can find each topic easily.

| Page | What visitors can explore |
|---|---|
| Home | My background, career goals, skills, and education |
| CEP Dashboard | TBFI project objectives, coding workflow, and evidence needed for validation |
| CSS/SCSS | Theme settings, code examples, and a visible custom style |
| Listings | Project cards with categories and filtering |

## Learning reflection draft

Building this project helps me understand how separate QMD files work together as a website. The dashboard focuses on selected project information, while the listings organize content for visitors. Keeping the styling in an SCSS file also makes the design easier to maintain. Before submitting, I need to preview every page and confirm that the published links work.
